glioma.selection: Practical authorized direct-download choice; not a claim of largest available cohort
glioma.citation: Antonelli et al. The Medical Segmentation Decathlon. Nature Communications 13, 4128 (2022). doi:10.1038/s41467-022-30695-9; cite BraTS source publications too.
glioma.count_note: 750 4D case volumes, not 3,000 patients. Unique clinical patient identity not independently established. BraTS 2016/17 overlap; do not pool as independent cohorts.
glioma.download_probe: 200 HEAD, Content-Length 7608266240, Accept-Ranges bytes; official MONAI 1.5.1 MD5 verified; payload not fetched.
limitations: 7.61 GB archive (7.09 GiB), confirmed by HEAD; extraction needs additional storage. The previous notebook 2 GB estimate is incorrect.
Training masks only for 484 cases; not all 750.
Already represented in the segmentation project: reuse any existing verified archive in this acquisition destination; do not duplicate under BraTS names.
License must also be confirmed from extracted dataset.json; no clinical approval is implied.

meningioma.selection: Verified ungated structural-MRI alternative to larger controlled-access releases
meningioma.citation: Filimonova et al. Multimodal Brain MRI and Clinical Data in Olfactory Groove Meningioma: A Prospective Data Report. doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds007345.v1.0.0
meningioma.download_probe: All 179 selected S3 assets returned HEAD 200 with matching byte sizes and Range support. Every publisher SHA256E pointer was verified. No MRI payload fetched in Cloud.
limitations: Single center, olfactory groove subtype only; not representative of all meningiomas.
Only baseline structural images and available tumor/edema masks selected; DWI, fMRI, processed diffusion and all postoperative repeats excluded.
T1 run numbers do not reliably establish pre/post contrast; retain contrast_unspecified until source metadata review.
Edema masks are not supplied for every patient; missing is not a healthy label.

brain_metastasis.license: Unresolved at dataset level; official benchmark README explicitly prohibits commercial use
brain_metastasis.reason: No verified direct automated MRI download selected. The official UCSF-BMSR v1.3 portal requires a reCAPTCHA challenge on Download; its actual MRI endpoint and publisher checksum were not verified. UCSD-BMETS-Longitudinal publishes an Aspera transfer. No challenge is bypassed and no third-party slice mirror is substituted.
brain_metastasis.citation: Rudie et al. UCSF-BMSR MRI Dataset. Radiology: Artificial Intelligence (2024), e230126. doi:10.1148/ryai.230126
limitations: This is an unresolved verification gap, not evidence that no qualifying brain-metastasis dataset exists.

UCSF-BMSR advertises 412 patients/560 exams but only 461 public exams; independent patient count in that subset is not established. UCSD alternative has 300 subjects and 163 GB, CC BY 4.0; repeat studies are not independent patients.

alzheimers.license: Not established for a qualifying directly downloadable clinical MRI cohort
alzheimers.reason: No clinical in-vivo 3D MRI cohort with reliable diagnosis, current no-registration access, and verified research permissions established. OASIS official pages return 503; ADNI/AIBL access is controlled. OpenNeuro ds004767 is ex-vivo temporal-lobe tissue, unsuitable as a clinical whole-brain disease class.
alzheimers.citation: OASIS alternatives require current access/terms verification before selection.
limitations: Do not label every OASIS subject as Alzheimer disease or equate CDR alone with biomarker-confirmed diagnosis.
Zenodo 7048297 contains a PDF, not the claimed MRI dataset; public article access does not establish data access.
No claim that no qualifying dataset exists; selection is unresolved.

post_stroke.selection: Verified public multi-center annotated stroke alternative; acute lesions, not chronic T1-only ATLAS
post_stroke.citation: Hernandez Petzsche et al. ISLES 2022: A multi-center magnetic resonance imaging stroke lesion segmentation dataset. Scientific Data 9, 762 (2022). doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01875-5; dataset doi:10.5281/zenodo.7153326
post_stroke.download_probe: HEAD 200 with matching 1692717470 byte size. Official open-access Zenodo record and publisher MD5 verified; no payload fetched in Cloud.
limitations: 250 public training cases, not the 400-case full challenge cohort.
Acute/subacute ischemic lesions; not a substitute for chronic post-stroke T1 structural lesions.
FLAIR, DWI and ADC remain in native space; do not assume cross-sequence registration.
No normal/control subjects; IXI differs in modality, age distribution and scanner protocol.
